name: obyte-mcp
description: Query Obyte mainnet and testnet hubs: balances, units, autonomous agents, AA state, AA dry runs, and token symbols.
long_description: Local stdio MCP server that serves both Obyte networks at once. Every tool accepts an optional "network" ("mainnet" or "testnet"); when omitted it uses the default network configured below. Read/query/dry-run only: it is not a wallet, signer, or broadcaster and never needs private keys.

tools.name: obyte_analyze_address
tools.description: Balances, definition, profile units, attestations, and optional history for an address.

tools.name: obyte_analyze_unit
tools.description: Fetch a unit joint and optionally follow its AA response chain.

tools.name: obyte_analyze_aa
tools.description: AA balances, selected state vars, and optional AA responses.

tools.name: obyte_resolve_asset
tools.description: Resolve an asset id or token symbol to asset, symbol, and decimals.

tools.name: obyte_prepare_aa_dry_run
tools.description: Validate and dry-run an AA trigger without signing or broadcasting.

tools.name: obyte_get_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Balances for up to 20 addresses in one call.

default_network.title: Default network
default_network.description: Network used when a tool call does not specify one. Both networks stay available regardless. Use "mainnet" or "testnet".

testnet_token_registry.title: Testnet token registry AA (optional)
testnet_token_registry.description: Token registry AA address used for testnet symbol lookups. Leave empty on mainnet-only usage.
